name: Your Company brand tokens
status: canonical machine-readable brand spec; subordinate to brand/LOGO_RULES.md and the Tier 1 rules in CLAUDE.md wherever they overlap

logo.rule: Fixed mark. Reproduce from approved masters only. Never recreate, restyle, stretch, rotate, skew, recolor, outline, or add effects. Only the background behind the mark may change.
logo.pairing: Light background takes the black mark. Dark background takes the silver-on-dark lockup. Never the black mark on a dark panel; never hand-invert a mark.

website.theme: MCA Denver motif: bright, minimal, corporate
website.accent: PENDING Owner decision; do not invent one

donts.note: Tier 1 rules encoded as enforceable checks. banned_strings fail a client export (whole-word, case-insensitive). warn_strings are voice violations that warn but do not fail. Supplier names stay in the out-of-repo local list (suppliers.local.txt); they are commercial data and never belong in this file.
rules: No supplier names or MATERIAL_COSTS on any client-facing surface
No precedent projects on bids (capability statements only)
No em-dashes in any user-facing output
Never recreate or recolor the logo; masters only
Deck supply and installation always in scope, never optional
Engineering folded into fab and erection rates, never line-itemed
